cohort: The study included 40,160 nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex presentation patients from Northwestern U.S. hospitals who were allowed to labor without a scheduled cesarean birth and were not intrapartum transfers or community births.
finding: South Asians had elevated adjusted odds for unplanned cesarean birth compared to Whites (aOR 2.18, CI 1.95-2.44) and other races and ethnicities, despite lower risk factor incidence.
mod_finding: South Asians had significantly higher adjusted odds of unplanned cesarean birth compared to Whites, Southeast Asians, and Asian unspecified groups, while East Asians had lower odds.
